page.overview:
Who is Farmer Peréz?

Farmer Peréz is a farmer who owns a farm in West Texas during the events of .

In 2022, Peréz's farm was devastated by a swarm of giant locusts which destroyed her crops. After this, she calls Dr. Ellie Sattler to investigate and complains to Sattler that the Department of Fish and Wildlife didn't even want to see the locust, as they are more concerned with activity concerning dinosausr. She also informs Sattler that her neighbor's crops were unscathed from the locusts as they used seeds manufactured by Biosyn and that her children, Alicia and Ramon, captured a live locust that Sattler took a sample of and later took the live locust to Dr. Alan Grant.
